S1.source: text/medi-103-e38972-s001.txt, [TABLE 1] (Supplementary Table S1, converted from files/medi-103-e38972-s001.docx)
S1.description: Instruments for the 41 systemic inflammatory regulators. In the converted table each regulator is one row whose cells hold space-separated per-SNP lists (SNP, chr, pos, alleles, exposure and outcome beta/SE/P, F). This copy was generated mechanically: each cell was split on whitespace and the i-th items written to one row per SNP; every value is copied verbatim, the regulator label goes to 'exposure', 'Number of SNPs' is kept on the first row of each block, and 'source_line' gives the line in the converted text file. List lengths were checked against 'Number of SNPs' for every regulator.

LiuY2024Med-1.notes: IL6 = 'IL-6' block of Supplementary Table S1 (4 SNPs, matching Figure 1 'IL-6 4 SNP, OR 1.351'). Outcome = GCST90044411 endometriosis (only outcome in the table; outcome betas given on the exposure effect allele, no outcome allele columns). The fixed-effect IVW recomputed from these rows is log-OR 0.557 (OR 1.75) vs reported OR 1.351; the rows are the only IL-6 instruments in the paper, so the label-based mapping is kept. Possible cause: rs13412535 is also a PDGFbb instrument (opposite exposure sign for the same G allele) despite the stated removal of SNPs shared between regulators, suggesting a table/analysis inconsistency in the source.

LiuY2024Med-2.notes: PDGFB = 'PDGFbb' block of Supplementary Table S1 (18 SNPs, matching Figure 1). Outcome = GCST90044411 endometriosis; outcome betas given on the exposure effect allele.
